core: an agent that just succeeded on a task tends to repeat that same recent successful action sequence on a new, different task where it no longer fits, and clearing the session history right before the new task removes this tendency and lets it choose correctly
quote_1: clear the session, hand it the same ticket cold, and it picks the correct merge strategy first try
quote_2: Clearing prior-session traces reduced these errors to 3%, with little effect on ordinary billing performance.
